cases.name: a-unique-email-over-a-generator-pack
cases.description: common.internet.email composes each address, so there is no list to draw from without replacement; check called it valid and the run refused
cases.config: <tdc><env count="20" seed="v" local="en"><sequence name="X" uniq="true"><gen type="template" value="common.internet.email"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{X}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-generator-pack-behind-a-literal
cases.description: one drawn part beside a literal takes the same draw, and is refused the same way
cases.config: <tdc><env count="20" seed="v" local="en"><sequence name="X" uniq="true"><data>id-</data><gen type="template" value="common.internet.email"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{X}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-generator-pack-beside-a-named-field
cases.description: one drawn part beside a field: the run still draws that part without replacement
cases.config: <tdc><env count="20" seed="v" local="en"><sequence name="X" uniq="true"><gen type="template" value="common.internet.email"/><gen name="f" type="number" value="1..9"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{X}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-builtin-date-template
cases.description: person.b_day computes a date; it is not a list either
cases.config: <tdc><env count="20" seed="v" local="en"><sequence name="X" uniq="true"><gen type="template" value="person.b_day"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{X}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-date-range
cases.description: a date range has no list of values to draw from without replacement
cases.config: <tdc><env count="20" seed="v" local="en"><sequence name="X" uniq="true"><gen type="date" value="2020-01-01..2020-12-31"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{X}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-timeseries
cases.description: a series is computed, not listed
cases.config: <tdc><env count="20" seed="v" local="en"><sequence name="X" uniq="true"><gen type="timeseries" base="10"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{X}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-text-list-with-percent
cases.description: percent= fixes how many rows each value fills, which a unique draw cannot keep
cases.config: <tdc><env count="20" seed="v" local="en"><sequence name="X" uniq="true"><gen type="text" value="a,b,c" percent="50,30,20"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{X}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-number-with-decimals
cases.description: only a plain integer range can be drawn without replacement
cases.config: <tdc><env count="20" seed="v" local="en"><sequence name="X" uniq="true"><gen type="number" value="1..100" decimals="2"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{X}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-number-from-a-distribution
cases.description: a distribution is not a range of listed integers
cases.config: <tdc><env count="20" seed="v" local="en"><sequence name="X" uniq="true"><gen type="number" distribution="normal" mean="5" sd="1"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{X}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-value-list-pack-is-drawn-uniquely
cases.description: person.lastName is a list: uniq draws from it without replacement, and check stays quiet
cases.config: <tdc><env count="20" seed="v" local="en"><sequence name="X" uniq="true"><gen type="template" value="person.lastName"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{X}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-compound-over-a-generator-pack-is-rearranged
cases.description: named fields are rearranged, not redrawn, so a generator field is fine
cases.config: <tdc><env count="20" seed="v" local="en"><sequence name="X" uniq="true"><gen name="e" type="template" value="common.internet.email"/><gen name="n" type="number" value="1..9"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{X}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-uniq-group-over-a-generator-pack
cases.description: an env-level <uniq> group rearranges finished columns, whatever made them
cases.config: <tdc><env count="20" seed="v" local="en"><uniq><sequence name="X"><gen type="template" value="common.internet.email"/></sequence><sequence name="Y"><gen type="number" value="1..9"/></sequence></uniq></env><block><line><data>${{X}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-regex-is-drawn-uniquely
cases.description: a pattern has a countable space and takes the unique draw
cases.config: <tdc><env count="20" seed="v" local="en"><sequence name="X" uniq="true"><gen type="regex" value="[A-Z]{3}[0-9]{3}"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{X}}</data></line></block></tdc>
